description:
Make error codes and user-facing strings provider-neutral — both to satisfy the no-AI-tool-names-in-user-errors rule and to avoid emitting a "Codex" code on a Gemini failure.

- Rename `ErrorCode.CODEX_TIMEOUT` → `REVIEW_TIMEOUT` and `CODEX_PARSE_ERROR` → `RESPONSE_PARSE_ERROR` (src/utils/errors.ts); update ALL references (client.ts:205-210, 230, 237 + every test/snapshot that asserts them).
- Neutralize `SERVER_INSTRUCTIONS` (server.ts:17) and the CLI program description (cli/commands.ts:102): drop "OpenAI Codex" → "automated code review". (Setup/install docs MAY still name the concrete backend.)

Land as an ISOLATED mechanical commit so it doesn't add noise to the Gemini diff. Note (adversarial): these error codes are embedded in user-facing message strings consumed by Claude Code, so this is a deliberate contract change — update assertions intentionally, don't paper over them.
Acceptance: green suite; no `CODEX_*` codes remain; no AI tool name in generic error/instruction strings.
title: Generic-ize error codes + neutralize backend-named user strings
